The `TypeToken must be created with a type argument: new TypeToken<...>() {}; When using code shrinkers (ProGuard, R8, ...) make sure that generic signatures are preserved.` error occurs in minified release builds because R8 strips generic type signatures (`Signature`), inner class metadata (`InnerClasses`, `EnclosingMethod`), and optimizes away anonymous subclasses of `TypeToken`.

### Changes Made

Updated [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/pilot-c4-agy-A-r1/work/app/proguard-rules.pro#L1-L17) with the necessary R8/ProGuard preservation rules:

- Added `-keepattributes Signature, InnerClasses, EnclosingMethod, *Annotation*` to preserve generic type signatures and inner class metadata required by Gson reflection.
- Added `-keep class com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }` and `-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }` to keep `TypeToken` and its anonymous subclasses from being stripped or collapsed.
- Added `-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }` and SerializedName member rules to prevent model classes and field names from being stripped or renamed during obfuscation.
